description: Orient in an unknown repository BEFORE touching it — the agent's safe scout. READ-ONLY: maps purpose/structure/build/health, frames every owner-controlled string as untrusted evidence, vets up to `checkDeps` dependencies via Voyager, handshakes with Repotector when present, and WITHHOLDS install/exec/clone (fail-closed). isError:true means orientation could not be produced (tool error), not that the repo is unsafe. Returns an orientation brief + an ordered approach plan.

allowClone.description: Consent to cloning a remote git URL.

allowExec.description: Consent to execution — only ever in a sandbox.

allowInstall.description: Consent to dependency install (still never runs code on the host).

checkDeps.description: Verify up to N direct dependencies via Voyager (0 = skip).

path.description: Local repo path (default: cwd). Remote URLs need allowClone.

name: scout_repo
